claims.summary: -아/어 있다 attaches to verbs that do not take an object and denotes a continuing state; the guide illustrates forms such as 열려 있다 and 놓여 있다.

findings: -아/어 있다 attaches to verbs that do not take an object and denotes a continuing state; the guide illustrates forms such as 열려 있다 and 놓여 있다.

limitations: La certificación se limita al contenido reescrito y a los localizadores registrados; no extiende los hallazgos a usos no tratados por esas fuentes.
